import json, subprocess, sys, time
CAND='/workspace/submission/main.py'
flow=dict(id='f',path=['a','b'],template='00'*8,kinds='QTKKKKKK',labels=[16,17])
r1=dict(mode='replay',capacities={'a':1,'b':1},flows=[flow],events=[
    dict(op='put',flow='f',node='a'),dict(op='put',flow='f',node='b'),dict(op='enable',flow='f'),
    dict(op='packet',flow='f',header='0003000000000000',payload='ff')])
r2=dict(mode='plan',capacities={'a':1,'b':1},flows=[dict(id='f',path=['a','b'],template='00'*8,kinds='QTKKKKKK')],
       warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={'f':[dict(header='0003000000000000',count=5)]})
lines=[json.dumps(r1),json.dumps(r2),json.dumps(r1),json.dumps(r2),'bad',json.dumps(r1)]
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND],input='\n'.join(lines)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
res=out.stdout.splitlines()
print('identical replay responses:', res[0]==res[2]==res[5])
print('identical plan responses :', res[1]==res[3])
print(res[0][:200]); print(res[1])
PYEOF

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# heavy mixed workload: 200 requests in one invocation
import json, subprocess, sys, time
CAND='/workspace/submission/main.py'
flow=dict(id='f',path=['a','b','c'],template='00'*64,kinds='QT'+'K'*61+'D',labels=[16,17,18])
evs=[dict(op='put',flow='f',node=n) for n in ['a','b','c']]+[dict(op='enable',flow='f')]+[dict(op='packet',flow='f',header='00'*64,payload='ab'*100) for _ in range(500)]
r1=json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities={'a':1,'b':1,'c':1},flows=[flow],events=evs))
r2=json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities={'a':2,'b':2},flows=[dict(id='f',path=['a','b'],template='00'*8,kinds='QTKKKKKK')],warmup=1,pinned=[],offers={'f':[dict(header='0003000000000000',count=5)]}))
lines=[r1,r2]*100
t0=time.time()
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND],input='\n'.join(lines)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('200 heavy requests: %.2fs, responses=%d, stdout=%d bytes'%(time.time()-t0, len(out.stdout.splitlines()), len(out.stdout)))
print(out.stdout.splitlines()[0][:100])
PYEOF
